notes.title: v1.0.8 - Long textbox patch
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where a hover text-box would always retain its largest size, even when text changes

This was most obvious when a packet drop would extend the text-box to be very large, then would not shrink when it would change to represent a normal ping value

notes.title: v1.0.7 - German

notes.title: v1.0.6 - Korean & Chinese translations
notes.content:

notes.title: v1.0.4 - Polish translations
notes.content: Added Polish language support, more languages to come

notes.title: v1.0.3 - Stats Panel
notes.content:
Added a stats panel to display simple information:
- Uptime
- Time since last fail (packet loss)
- Fail count

Also added some spacing of small pixel font to improve readability.

notes.title: v1.0.2 - Bugfix for non-English locales
notes.content:
Changes:
- Reimplemented ping handling entirely, as the old one was unreliable and broke on non-English locales (OS display language).
- More intricate system-provided error reports, which are now all coalesced into the "dropped packet" color (default red).
- Linux, which previously had trouble when started from the Steam library, may now work. Pending testing. Arch users may need to apply [url=https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/sysctl#Allow_unprivileged_users_to_create_IPPROTO_ICMP_sockets]this workaround (ArchLinux wiki)[/url]
